name: @solary/magpie-mistral-vibe
description: Mistral Vibe Code subscription as an OpenCode/magpie provider plugin (unofficial): browser sign-in mints an API key that bills the plan's monthly Vibe Code budget on api.mistral.ai

summary.en: Mistral Vibe Code subscription (unofficial): browser sign-in or a Vibe Code API key; chat completions on api.mistral.ai billed to the plan's monthly Vibe Code budget, with plan and budget usage. Separate from the mistral API-key provider.
summary.zh: Mistral Vibe Code 订阅（非官方）：浏览器登录或 Vibe Code API key；请求走 api.mistral.ai 并计入套餐月度 Vibe Code 预算，带 plan 与用量显示。与 mistral API key provider（mistral）相互独立。
